author: Cristian Lewczyk
description: A fastlane plugin that wraps the Samsung Galaxy Store Developer API. Provides actions for uploading APK/AAB binaries, syncing store listing metadata (including import from Google Play Supply), submitting apps for review, controlling publication timing, and managing staged rollouts.

author: Svend Gundestrup
description: A zero-config Jekyll plugin that content-tags supported local asset URLs in generated .html/.htm attributes at post_write. Covers matching markup emitted by themes and plugins without template changes. CSS/JS runtime references and HTTP cache headers are outside its scope.

author: Yuri Sidorov (@newstler)
description: Pairs a machine with git.broker, keeps one outbound connection, and when you ask from a PR card creates a worktree and runs your own agent there, headless or in your terminal.

author: Marlen Brunner
description: OMP Project Time work logs with an optional manual Harvest destination.
